methods.what: Definition of a Wronskian-type bilinear expression in two solutions differentiated with respect to a parameter
Second-order linear ODE in normal form
Differentiating the ODE with respect to the parameter kappa gives an inhomogeneous equation
Second derivative of p by product rule
